find.name: find
find.description: Locate a specific fact, document, owner, past decision, or current ticket/account status across enterprise systems.
trigger_conditions: Team explicitly asks where a doc, owner, past decision, or record lives and nobody has provided it.
Discussion stalls because participants lack a concrete factual lookup stored in Notion, Linear, Slack history, or CRM.
veto_conditions: A teammate already shared the link, owner, or accurate answer in recent turns.
Participants are casually reminiscing or explicitly agreed to check it offline later.

channel_policy.deescalation_rule: Prefer THREAD_BRIEF; drop to DM_NUDGE if only one person asked casually.

investigation_plan: Search Notion docs and Slack history for the named artifact, decision, or owner.
Check Linear issues or HubSpot/Google Calendar if ownership, status, or meeting context is referenced.
find.response_contract: State the exact answer first, cite source ID/title/date, and avoid extra background commentary.

explain.name: explain
explain.description: Clarify how an internal process, metric definition, billing rule, or technical mechanism works.
trigger_conditions: Participants express confusion or hold conflicting mental models about an internal term, process, or business rule.
A misunderstanding of how a system works is about to misguide an upcoming task.
veto_conditions: Participants are joking or speaking loosely without real operational confusion.
A domain expert in the channel is actively typing/explaining the same rule accurately.

channel_policy.deescalation_rule: Use THREAD_BRIEF for single-user questions; CHANNEL_INTERVENE only if whole team is aligned on a wrong rule.

investigation_plan: Retrieve authoritative specification from Notion wikis and runbooks.
Cross-check actual implementation or config notes in Linear or Slack engineering threads.
explain.response_contract: Give a crisp 2-3 sentence definition/mechanism backed by the authoritative Notion/Linear reference.

analyze.name: analyze
analyze.description: Combine and compare quantitative data from multiple sources to surface trends, metric changes, or operational patterns.
trigger_conditions: Team is debating a metric shift, conversion drop, revenue change, or growth trend without hard cross-source numbers.
An important business decision hinges on joining data across analytics, billing, or warehouse tables.
veto_conditions: Team is only doing early high-level brainstorming where approximate intuition is sufficient.
An analyst already committed to running the query and sharing a dashboard shortly.

channel_policy.deescalation_rule: Deliver compact key figures in THREAD_BRIEF; escalate to CHANNEL_INTERVENE only for major unexpected metric anomalies.

investigation_plan: Run targeted SQL queries on Snowflake or BigQuery for the exact timeframe and cohort.
Cross-validate directional trends against PostHog, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, or Stripe.
analyze.response_contract: Lead with headline numbers (exact timeframe, delta, %), cite tables/sources, keep under 100 words.

check.name: check
check.description: Verify whether a specific claim, date, figure, or assumption stated in chat accurately matches source-of-truth records.
trigger_conditions: A participant states a specific number, launch date, customer status, or contract fact that conflicts with source records.
Team is about to send external communications or commit to a plan relying on an unverified factual claim.
veto_conditions: Verification confirms the stated claim is already accurate—stay SILENT instead of saying 'looks right!'.
Discrepancy is trivial rounding with zero operational consequence.

channel_policy.deescalation_rule: Use DM_NUDGE if correcting a single person privately avoids embarrassment before external send; THREAD_BRIEF or CHANNEL_INTERVENE if group is acting on the error.

investigation_plan: Identify the primary system of record (Stripe for billing, HubSpot for CRM, Linear for dates/bugs, Snowflake for metrics).
Cross-check against a second system if discrepancies exist across departments.
check.response_contract: Politely state Claim vs. Verified Source Fact with exact record ID/timestamp, no lecturing.

diagnose.name: diagnose
diagnose.description: Isolate the root cause of a technical, customer, billing, or pipeline failure and identify actionable remediation steps.
trigger_conditions: A customer bug, login/SSO failure, billing error, or metric pipeline break is reported without a confirmed root cause.
Team is chasing a wrong hypothesis when logs, tickets, or account records reveal the real cause.
veto_conditions: Root cause is already identified and an engineer is actively deploying the fix.
Symptom is a transient blip with no confirming evidence in enterprise tools.

channel_policy.deescalation_rule: Use CHANNEL_INTERVENE for active customer-facing incidents; THREAD_BRIEF for isolated ticket triage.

investigation_plan: Check Linear issues and Slack incident/engineering channels for matching error signatures or recent deploys.
Inspect affected customer records in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, or Snowflake logs to isolate scope and root cause.
diagnose.response_contract: Format as Root Cause -> Supporting Evidence (IDs/timestamps) -> Concrete Next Fix.

decide.name: decide
decide.description: Compare competing options against concrete constraints and data to formulate a clear, reasoned recommendation.
trigger_conditions: Team is deadlocked between concrete options or about to pick an option that violates known capacity, cost, or SLA constraints.
Relevant quantitative trade-offs exist across enterprise systems that the group has not synthesized.
veto_conditions: Decision is a pure taste/subjective call or executive prerogative with no missing objective evidence.
Decision-maker already finalized the choice and moved to execution.

channel_policy.deescalation_rule: Keep recommendations humble and scoped to THREAD_BRIEF or DM_NUDGE to preserve human decision ownership.

investigation_plan: Gather hard constraints from Notion roadmaps, Linear workload, and Google Calendar deadlines.
Pull customer/revenue impact from HubSpot, Stripe, or Snowflake to rank options objectively.
decide.response_contract: Present concise 2-option comparison with evidence-backed trade-offs and 1 clear recommendation.

coordinate.name: coordinate
coordinate.description: Align cross-functional stakeholders, surface hidden cross-channel dependencies, and clarify ownership or handoffs.
trigger_conditions: One team's timeline or announcement contradicts another team's plan/delay recorded in another channel, Linear, or Calendar.
Action items have stalled with unclear ownership or a forgotten stakeholder who must sign off.
veto_conditions: Owners and timelines are already explicitly assigned and acknowledged by all parties.
Cross-team sync is already scheduled on Google Calendar with the right attendees.

channel_policy.deescalation_rule: Use DM_NUDGE to gently remind a single owner; THREAD_BRIEF/CHANNEL_INTERVENE when two teams have an active schedule clash.

investigation_plan: Scan cross-department Slack channels, Linear sprint milestones, and Google Calendar events.
Identify exact owners and conflicting dates from Notion project briefs or HubSpot deal timelines.
coordinate.response_contract: Name the exact misalignment, involved owners, verified dates/tickets, and one crisp coordination action.

guard.name: guard
guard.description: Screen proposed actions, data shares, or access requests against internal security, privacy, permission, and compliance policies.
trigger_conditions: A team member proposes sharing restricted PII, financial data, credentials, or granting access violating Notion security/compliance policy.
External disclosure or contract commitment conflicts with legal, billing, or access rules.
veto_conditions: Action is already compliant or explicitly approved by authorized security/legal owner.
Hypothetical policy discussion with no imminent risky action.

channel_policy.deescalation_rule: DEFAULT TO DM_NUDGE to avoid public shaming or amplifying sensitive data; use THREAD_BRIEF only if urgent group-wide stop is needed.

investigation_plan: Locate exact security, privacy, or access-control policy in Notion.
Verify user role, customer tier, or contract clause in HubSpot, Stripe, or Slack policy announcements.
guard.response_contract: Flag the specific policy clause neutrally, state the safe compliant alternative, and never repeat raw sensitive secrets.
